# screenstudio-export

> Export macOS Screen Studio `.screenstudio` project bundles to finished MP4 using
> Python and ffmpeg — no Screen Studio app, no subscription. Reproduces zoom,
> animated cursor, webcam bubble, cuts, and custom/frame-image backgrounds.
> Not affiliated with Screen Studio; reads the .screenstudio format for interoperability.

## What it solves
- Screen Studio is free to record and edit, but exporting is subscription-gated ($108/year as of 2026) and .screenstudio files open in no other tool.
- This tool renders bundles you already have, offline and free, on your own machine.
- Also extracts raw footage / voice tracks for editing in Premiere, Resolve, or Final Cut.

## Docs
- README (install, workflow, use cases, FAQ): /README.md
- .screenstudio bundle format reference: /docs/format.md
- Scripts: /scripts/inspect_bundle.py, /scripts/prepare_render.py, /scripts/cursor_layer.py
- Claude Code skill: clone into ~/.claude/skills/ and ask Claude to export your bundle.

## Key questions answered
- How to export a Screen Studio project without a subscription
- How to open or convert a .screenstudio file without the app
- What is inside a .screenstudio file (format documentation)
- How to recover recordings after a lapsed Screen Studio subscription
- How to batch/headless render Screen Studio projects (CLI/CI)
